_note: Issue #1169 (S1) seed-corpus manifest. Each entry is a REAL document fetched from its source site and verified at build time (2026-10-25) — never stub text. Ingestion happens through the admin upload route (POST /api/knowledge/corpus): upload the bytes from sourceUrl and confirm the returned contentHash matches sha256 below before treating the document as seeded. Entries with fetchStatus other than 'verified' are NOT seeded: the NVIDIA 10-K automated fetch was rejected by SEC's bot gate (both User-Agents tried) and must be ingested from a human browser session, which SEC permits. No entry may be replaced with hand-written text. knowledge/ keys are corpus, not reports, and are excluded from the #1168 orphan sweep by design (no mas_reports row).
